ms.promise:
・A set of stubs of the main system components to serve as placeholders for further development. The main system components are: Kubernetes operator, Management Web UI, Management CLI, API Interface.
・A CI/CD workflow to build and test the source-code throughout the whole development process of the system. At this initial stage, the pipeline will build and execute the dummy artifacts and tests provided by each of the available stubs.
・Developer documentation for further development of the system. This includes: developer guidelines, local environment instructions, CI pipeline description / usage.
ms.criteria:
・All components are ready for further development by replacing stubs with real implementations.
・A CI/CD pipeline is in place to build / test the different components.
・Repository contains instructions for further development.
・Repository source-code shows its licensed under Apache 2.0 license.
